34	    .limit(1)
35	    .single()

37	  if (!['owner', 'admin'].includes(member.role)) {
38	    return new Response('Forbidden', { status: 403 })
39	  }
40	
41	  const { data: sub } = await supabase
42	    .from('subscriptions')
43	    .select('plan_tier')

46	    .maybeSingle()

48	  const gate = requireFeature(plan, 'inventory')
49	  if (gate) return gate
50	
51	  const { data: item } = await supabase
52	    .from('inventory_items')
53	    .select('id, studio_id, current_stock')
54	    .eq('id', id)
55	    .eq('studio_id', member.studio_id)
56	    .single()

61	    return Response.json({ error: body.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 })
62	  }
63

68	    return Response.json(
69	      { error: `Adjustment would result in negative stock (${qty_after})` },
70	      { status: 400 },
71	    )
72	  }
73

87	    .single()

91	    return Response.json({ error: 'Failed to record adjustment' }, { status: 500 })
92	  }
93	
94	  return Response.json({ data }, { status: 201 })
